claim: Onboarding proposal §3 Phase 1 lane OB-2 and §4 F14 ("one RPC that takes values TS computed"), closing audit gap G16; the session's call under the founder's /goal 2026-11-07 ("Do not ask me any questions I approve you decide them all"). AuthService.createFirstHouse computes and checks every value in TS (slug, place id and its look-up, coordinates, zone, currency, the 409 rule) and writes the house through exactly one `open_first_house` RPC call; it calls no .insert/.update/.delete and names none of organizations, restaurants, user_onboarding_progress, organization_members, user_restaurant_access in a .from(), so no compensating delete exists to fail. The migration *_the_first_house_opens_in_one_transaction.sql makes open_first_house SECURITY INVOKER with search_path pinned, revokes it from public and from anon, authenticated, and grants it to service_role only. Behaviour is proved by house-opening.spec.ts t1 (access row and clean-up both fail: zero organizations/restaurants rows; on origin/main an organization survives) and t2 (the retry opens the house; on origin/main it answers 409), and by supabase/tests/*_the_first_house_opens_in_one_transaction_test.sql T1-T6 in a PGlite full-corpus build. Known limits: the verify reads source shape, not behaviour; PGlite runs migrations as superuser with the platform stubbed.
